title: Review joint A: declaration fidelity and model-to-PFSE scope

handoff.objective: Review joint A: declaration fidelity and model-to-PFSE scope
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Exact independent mathematical scope and model semantics; no ECDLP algorithm inference.
constraints: Zero scientific trials, formal builds, formalization runs, solver sweeps and benchmarks.
Preserve original sources, proof/specification/receipt bytes and existing statuses. No new EV/DEC/H records, scientific promotion, global lower bound, speedup or goal completion.
Only driving Coordinator performs Git, claims, publication, canonical queue updates and archive binding.
Missing custody/input/independence is an unresolved gate, never a mathematical negative or permission to fabricate an attestation.
Fresh session fork_turns=none, distinct from producer, B and Coordinator. No sibling report/conversation reads.
Own joint A only; apply every worked attack/control in the pre-dispatch plan. Do not claim B's result.
Escalate any proposed stronger-than-model closure to proper claim-tier review; this packet admits none.
completion_gate: Clause-to-declaration map covers exact named audited theorem versus bundled optimum/attainment assertions.
Optimized/pointwise, infimum/minimum, H1-H4, mean/success/rank, growing-arity m!, r^o(1), source scale and full-pipeline interfaces explicit.
Attestation has review_attestation root, task_id, joints_owned ['A'], verdicts {'A': holds|breaks|inconclusive}, exact sources_read and truthful actual runtime/session/model/effort/independence.
All exact declared artifacts present; actual commands, limitations and session provenance reported.
handoff.return_format: Artifact paths, checks, honest scope and unresolved gates.
